# INC-20191206-b34375 — grafana: Goavro doesn't compile on 32-bit systems.

**SEV2** · **DIAGNOSED** · fired 2019-12-06T12:10:07+00:00 · diagnosed in 8.7s (3 tool calls)

## Summary

413be3a6a0 vendors github.com/linkedin/goavro and imports it from pkg/extensions/main.go, so every Grafana build now compiles goavro, which does not build for 32-bit targets.

**Offending commit:** `413be3a6a0` · **Confidence:** 90% (high)

## Root-cause analysis

The report names the library. This is the only commit in the window that adds it, and the import in pkg/extensions puts it in every build. The runner-up is a TypeScript UI change and can't affect Go compilation.

### Evidence

- 413be3a6a0 adds vendor/github.com/linkedin/goavro and an import in pkg/extensions/main.go
- go.mod gains the goavro requirement in the same commit
- 047abc87c2 only touches packages/grafana-ui TypeScript

- 047abc87c2: UI-only TypeScript change
